name: rosetta-jacobi-symbol
code:
use default

jacobi(a: int, n: int) -> int is
    assert n > 0 /\ n % 2 == 1 else "n must be positive and odd"

    let numerator mut = ((a % n) + n) % n
    let denominator mut = n
    let symbol mut = 1

    while numerator != 0 do
        while numerator % 2 == 0 do
            numerator = numerator / 2

            let eighth = denominator % 8

            if eighth == 3 \/ eighth == 5 then
                symbol = -symbol
            fi
        od

        let previous = denominator

        denominator = numerator
        numerator = previous

        if numerator % 4 == 3 /\ denominator % 4 == 3 then
            symbol = -symbol
        fi

        numerator = numerator % denominator
    od

    return if denominator == 1 then symbol else 0 fi
si

let columns = 0::20

write_line("n\\a{columns |> map(a => "{a,3}") |> join("")}")

for n in (1::19) |> filter(n => n % 2 == 1) do
    let row = columns |> map(a => "{jacobi(a, n),3}") |> join("")

    write_line("{n,3}{row}")
od
